description: Pay a USD order without its payment link, with a Stripe shared payment token: for an agent that can request one from the user's Link wallet (US and Canadian accounts), and for an order whose text has a "Pay without the link" line, which gives the business_profile and the usage limits to request the token with. Any other order is paid by its link. It takes the orderId, the token as sharedPaymentToken and the order's total; a token pays one order. On success the order is confirming with its payment held, and its payment link stops working; a failure leaves the link open, and each error says how to recover.

orderId.description: The orderId of the order to pay.

sharedPaymentToken.description: The shared payment token (spt_…) the user approved for this order, requested with the usage limits the order gives for a token (payment.tokenRequest.usageLimits).

total.description: The total the user approved: the order's total, amount and currency, exactly as the order gives it (total). In USD: a token pays a USD order only, and any other order is paid by its payment link.

amount.description: Decimal string such as 132.40, never a number.

name: pay_order
title: Pay order
